system.description: A Focus for emitting and manipulating lightning and thunder.

abilities.name: Control Electric Device
abilities.description: Control or disrupt a non-intelligent electrical device at long range, treating an attack roll below 12 as a 12.

abilities.name: Lightning Hand
abilities.description: Make a touch or long-range lightning attack for 4 damage, or charge a weapon to deal 1 additional damage.

abilities.name: Thunder Crash
abilities.description: Strike a long-range target with thunder for 2 damage and a continuing tremor that can deal 1 damage each round.

abilities.name: Resist the Storm
abilities.description: Choose electricity or sonic energy and reduce wounds from that energy by one step; choose the other energy if selected again.

abilities.name: Bolt Rider
abilities.description: Move a long distance almost instantly as a bolt of lightning to a visible location without intervening barriers.

abilities.name: Radiohead
abilities.description: Transmit and receive radio communications across a broad range of frequencies, including encrypted signals with an Intellect task.

abilities.name: Deafening Bolt
abilities.description: Strike a long-range target with lightning for 5 damage and deafen it until a ten-minute recovery.

abilities.name: Electric Armor
abilities.description: Surround yourself with electricity that damages melee attackers, ignores minor and moderate electrical wounds, and enables a 2-damage touch attack.

abilities.name: Bolts of Power
abilities.description: Launch four lightning bolts at up to four nearby targets for 4 damage each, dealing 1 damage even on a miss.

abilities.name: Subsonic Rumble
abilities.description: Emit a subsonic rumble that hinders nearby creatures by two steps on persuasion, intimidation, and fear tasks.

abilities.name: Discharge
abilities.description: Project visible energy at up to three nearby targets for 4 damage each, with Effort able to remove a target’s next turn.

abilities.name: Electric Flight
abilities.description: While Electric Armor is active, fly a short distance and act or move a long distance, carrying one creature safely.

abilities.name: Flash Across the Miles
abilities.description: Travel almost instantly as lightning to a familiar outdoor or sky-open location on the same planet.

abilities.name: Wall of Lightning
abilities.description: Create a six-panel barrier of crackling electricity that deals 10 damage nearby and double damage when crossed.
